serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Meridian Secure Workspace (MSW) is a cloud-native SaaS collaboration and document-management platform built on a FedRAMP Certified underlying IaaS platform. MSW provides real-time document co-authoring, secure messaging, and workflow automation for federal agency teams.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Meridian FedRAMP-compatible trust center: certification package, ongoing certification reports, and significant change notifications.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Federal agency personnel may request access via the 'Request Access' button on the trust center homepage using a .gov or .mil email address. Access is typically granted within 2 business days.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Instructions for securely configuring top-level administrative accounts and tenant security settings for Meridian Secure Workspace.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Independent assessment materials, including the most recent annual independent assessment summary.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Available to leveraging agencies upon request through the trust center access request form.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Real-time collaborative document editing with version history and audit trail.
End-to-end encrypted messaging and file sharing between authenticated tenant users.
Configurable approval-routing and task-automation engine for document workflows.

certified.useCase: Underlying IaaS platform providing compute, block storage, and virtual networking for all MSW production workloads.

nonCertified.name: SendGrid Email Delivery API
nonCertified.useCase: Outbound transactional email notifications only (no federal data content); connection is outbound-only and does not process or store CUI.
